items.summary: SEC staff’s no-action letter covers CC earned by running infrastructure and applications, but is not a binding ruling on its legal status.

items.title: ASSOCHAM seeks Customs amnesty scheme to settle ₹1.5 trillion disputes
items.summary: In its pre-Budget memorandum, ASSOCHAM has proposed a one-time Customs amnesty scheme, tax incentives for manufacturers and lower long-term capital gains tax rates

items.title: Midterms Blue Wave Makes $917K for One Polymarket Trader, If Alaska Doesn’t Flip
items.summary: A Polymarket trader topped the prediction market’s leaderboard after Democrats swept the US midterms, but Alaska could still flip it.
